copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 里安装 claude-mem 后,它会启动本地 worker(或连接远程 worker),Claude 通过 MCP 服务 claude-mem-local / claude-mem-remote 与它通信。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上配置 claude-mem 时触发,适用于本地或远程 worker、本地 host-login 或 cmem.ai 远程推理等场景。

say.text: 在 Cursor 里安装 claude-mem 的本地 worker
把 claude-mem 的 provider 改成 host,走本地登录

howto.what_en: After installing in Cursor, claude-mem starts a local worker (or connects to a remote one), and Claude talks to it through the MCP servers claude-mem-local / claude-mem-remote.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai inference.

say_en.text: Install the claude-mem local worker in Cursor
Set up claude-mem as a remote worker at https://YOUR_HOST
Switch the claude-mem provider to host for local login
